text.ACTIVITY_JACKPOT_POINT_HELP: You will get 1 point for each Energy consumed. Rewards will be issued via Mail when you acquire the required number of points!
text.ACTIVITY_JACKPOT_HELP_TEXT: 1. Use Jackpot Energy (5 energy for each spin) to spin Basic Jackpot and Super Jackpot for item rewards Jackpot Points or Super Jackpot Points. If two or more of the same girl is displayed in the result Jackpot Points or Super Jackpot Points will be rewarded based on which Jackpot you were spinning from. If all of the girls displayed in the result are different a random item reward will be given.|2. You can choose the amount of Jackpot Energy you want to use before each spin. If you choose to consume multiple times of Jackpot Energy in the next spin the reward for the spin will thus be multiplied.|3. Super Jackpot will be unlocked after acquiring Advanced Access or spinning the Basic Jackpot 40 times.|4. Jackpot Points and Super Jackpot Points can be used to draw from Basic Draw and Super Draw respectively. After getting all the rewards of Basic Draw/Super Draw the rewards of Basic Draw/Super Draw will be reset.|5. Additional rewards will also be granted based on the amount of Jackpot Energy you consumed in the event.|6. Advanced Access will be removed after the event ends.|7. After the event ends any remaining Jackpot Energy Jackpot Points and Super Jackpot Points will be removed from your account and changed into Coins. Jackpot Energy will be transformed into 25K Coins each Jackpot Points will be transformed into 25K Coins each and Super Jackpot Points will be transformed into 50K Coins each. The Coins will be sent via Mail.
text.ACTIVITY_JACKPOT_ENERGY_USE_TIPS: You will get the reward {1} times
text.ACTIVITY_JACKPOT_TIPS: Purchase Advanced Access or spin the Basic Jackpot {1} time(s) (every 5 Jackpot Energy consumed will count as 1 spin) to unlock Super Jackpot.
text.ACTIVITY_JACKPOT_DRAW_HELP: 1. Lucky Draw is separated into Basic Draw and Super Draw. Jackpot Points and Super Jackpot Points can be used to draw from Basic Draw and Super Draw respectively. Once all rewards from Basic Draw or Super Draw are claimed the limit for claiming the rewards will be reset.|2. After Advanced Access is acquired Jackpot Points can be exchanged to Super Jackpot Points at the rate of 1:1.|3. After the event ends any remaining Jackpot Points and Super Jackpot Points will be removed from your account and changed into Coins. Jackpot Points will be transformed into 25K Coins each and Super Jackpot Points will be transformed into 50K Coins each. The Coins will be sent via Mail.
text.ACTIVITY_JACKPOT_TEXT02: Congratulations you've unlocked Super Jackpot! Tap "Go" to check it out!
text.ACTIVITY_JACKPOT_EXCHANGE_TIPS: Senpai you've acquired the Advanced Access do you want to exchange your Jackpot Points for Super Jackpot Points now?
text.ACTIVITY_JACKPOT_WARN: Super Jackpot unlocked do you need to stop this spin and move to Super Jack Spot?
